title: 서점에서 추천 부탁하기: 어떤 책이 좋을까요?
objective: Politely ask for a recommendation and give your reason with -거든요.
summary: A customer asks a bookstore employee for a recommendation and explains with -거든요.
setting: A customer who is learning Korean asks a staff member at a bookstore to recommend a Korean novel.

task.title: Ask and explain politely
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to fill in blanks, put words in order, complete a conversation, and write your own request.

words.example: 이 근처 맛집 좀 추천해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please recommend a good restaurant near here.

words.meaning: Could you recommend (something)? — a polite request
words.example: 처음 와서 잘 모르는데, 추천해 주시겠어요?
words.exampleMeaning: It's my first time here, so I don't know much. Could you recommend something?

words.meaning: (it's) because… / you see — gives your reason or situation
words.exampleMeaning: No coffee for me, thanks. I already had some earlier.

words.meaning: to look for (an item in a shop)
How about…? — used to suggest something politely
words.exampleMeaning: How about a seat by the window?

words.meaning: easy (to do), convenient — after a verb + 기
words.exampleMeaning: This app is easy to use.
It was too hard, so I gave up halfway.

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, could you recommend a book?
Sure, what kind of book are you looking for?

dialogue.korean: 한국 소설을 읽어 보고 싶은데요. 한국어를 배운 지 2년밖에 안 됐거든요.
dialogue.meaning: I'd like to try reading a Korean novel. I've only been learning Korean for two years, you see.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 이 책은 어떠세요? 짧은 이야기가 여러 개 있어서 읽기 편해요.
dialogue.meaning: Then how about this book? It has several short stories, so it's easy to read.

dialogue.korean: 어려운 단어가 많지 않아요? 너무 어려우면 금방 포기하거든요.
dialogue.meaning: Doesn't it have a lot of difficult words? If it's too hard, I give up quickly.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -거든요 (use the verb in brackets): ① 가까운 병원 좀 추천해 주세요. 이 동네에 지난주에 처음 ____. (오다) ② 가벼운 노트북이 있어요? 매일 들고 ____. (다니다) ③ 쉬운 문제집 좀 추천해 주세요. 다음 주에 시험이 ____. (있다)
Put the words in order to make a polite request: 주시겠어요? / 운동화 / 추천해 / 좀
Complete the conversation: A: 어떤 선물을 찾으세요? B: 남동생 생일 선물인데요. 남동생이 축구를 ____. (좋아하다 + -거든요) A: 그럼 이 축구공은 ____? (How about it?)
Write two sentences in Korean: You are at a bakery. Ask the staff what would be good, then explain that you don't like sweet things very much. Use -거든요.
answers: ① 왔거든요 ② 다니거든요 ③ 있거든요
뭐가 좋을까요? 제가 단 걸 별로 안 좋아하거든요. (Other answers are fine, e.g. 뭐가 맛있어요? 저는 단 음식을 별로 안 좋아하거든요.)
